categorisation: This gazette content is a legal/regulatory notification issued under the Excise (Special Provisions) Act, No. 13 of 1989. It contains an order by the Minister of Finance that modifies excise duty rates on specific tobacco products, which constitutes a regulatory change. While it mentions a named minister (Mangala Samaraweera), it does not describe his portfolio responsibilities in detail - his title is stated but not elaborated upon. The core content is about amending existing regulations and specifying new tax rates, making it primarily a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel or structural change.
